gaps.concept: main habitat / research / engineering / emergency shelter
gaps.solution: Reuse the existing small habitat shell for these shared module roles; rooms remain the existing independent cutaway architecture, not a one-to-one exterior blueprint.
Closed doors are embedded in the supplied habitat/airlock artwork; InteractionAnchor reserves an access point. No new vacuum door logic.
Separate tube/corridor PNG is not available; do not imply utility_box is a pressurized corridor. Reserve a clear linkage area for Phase 0.9.
Only closed supplied texture is prepared; no opening/gas/collision toggling is invented.
Reuse connector/utility box for junctions; continuous cable runs remain an explicit noncritical art gap.
Existing crates, tool cases, canisters and support cargo provide reusable components; no new pallet artwork is essential.

gaps.concept: airlock approach / safety / navigation / service paths
gaps.solution: Existing beacon, pole light, hazard stripe pad and footpath overlays; labels are Godot controls.
Tank, sealed ECLSS cabinet, console, sensor and service markers are fictional near-future presentations; no engineering ratings.
